origin.description: Steady state of a 1-D difference scheme. One species uses a banded Jacobian.
origin.usage: steady.1D(y, time = NULL, func, parms = NULL, nspec = NULL, dimens = NULL, method = "stode", ...)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: nspec
arguments.text: Number of species. Required unless dimens is set.

origin.details: nspec 1 and method stode calls steady.band. Several species are reordered so the band is the species block, then restored.
origin.value: A steady1D list. dimens is the number of boxes.
origin.example:
g <- function(t, y, p) list(c(y[2] - y[1], 1 - y[2]))
steady.1D(y = c(0.2, 0.2), func = g, nspec = 1)

translation.description: Steady state of a 1-D difference scheme. One species uses a banded Jacobian.
translation.usage: steady_1d(y, times=None, func=None, parms=None, nspec=None, dimens=None, method="stode", **kwargs)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: nspec
arguments.text: Number of species. Required unless dimens is set.

translation.details: nspec 1 and method stode calls steady.band. Several species are reordered so the band is the species block, then restored.
translation.value: A steady1D list. dimens is the number of boxes.
translation.example:
from rootSolve import steady_1d

def g(t, y, p):
    return [[y[1] - y[0], 1 - y[1]]]

print(steady_1d([0.2, 0.2], func=g, nspec=1))
